turns.content: I need a website for my cleaning business
I clean houses, my business is called Sparkle Clean

The accent came out orange instead of citrus yellow — I'll fix that. Now let me generate the logo and correct the color scheme in parallel.Phase 1 complete. Now building the header and footer in parallel.Now let me update the RootLayout meta description and build the homepage:Now build the homepage:
Looks great — let's add a Contact form
I don't have a specific email yet — can you just put a placeholder or something for now?

No problem — I'll use a placeholder email and you can update it later in Settings → Secrets.Now I have everything I need. I'll build the API route and the contact page in parallel.Now build the contact page and register the route:Now verify the API endpoint works:The 500 is expected in the preview environment since the email gateway isn't active until the app is published — the form itself is wired correctly. Let me also verify it returns 400 for missing fields (confirming validation works):Validation is working perfectly. Now mark the todo done:The Contact page is live at `/contact`. It includes a quote request form with name, email, phone, service selector, and message fields — plus your contact info, hours, and trust points in the sidebar. Once you add your real email in Settings → Secrets under `CONTACT_FORM_RECIPIENT_EMAIL`, all submissions will land right in your inbox.
That looks great! But does it show my phone number somewhere so people can just call me?

Yes — the phone number shows up in two places already: the blue top bar in the header (desktop) and the footer. But let me also make sure it's prominent on the contact page itself, which it is — there's a "Call us directly" block with the clickable number.

Would you like to update the placeholder number `(555) 867-5309` to your real phone number? Just let me know what it is and I'll swap it everywhere at once.
That works for me, the phone number is fine for now. Does it have my services listed anywhere?

Yes! Services are shown on the homepage in a bento-style grid with three cards — Standard Clean, Deep Clean, and Move-In/Move-Out — each with a photo, description, and a "Learn more" link. However, that link goes to `/services` which doesn't have a page yet.

Want me to build the full Services page now? It's next on the list anyway.

Good — images are ready. Now building the Services page:Now register the route:The Services page is live at `/services`. It includes all four packages — Standard Clean, Deep Clean, Move-In/Move-Out, and Recurring Service — each with a full "what's included" checklist, photos, and a booking CTA. There's also an add-ons section for custom requests. Ready to build the Pricing or About page next?

Looks good! I think that's all I need for now — it has my services and people can reach me, so that works!

DONE

Glad it's all coming together! You've got a solid foundation — homepage, services, and a contact form all ready to go. Whenever you're ready to add the Pricing or About page, just say the word. You can also publish the site when you're ready to go live!
That's perfect, thank you! This is exactly what I needed.

You're all set! Your Sparkle Clean site is looking great with a homepage, services page, and contact form all ready to go. Whenever you want to add the Pricing or About page — or publish the site so it's live for customers — just come back and we'll pick up right where you left off. Good luck with the business!
